text:
The gap likely peaked at roughly 30 to 40 percentage points in the mid-1950s, with Southern approval of the Supreme Court's desegregation ruling far below the rest of the country. I can't check the exact Gallup figures from here, so treat that range as a recollection. The team note's claim that the gap was nearly the full scale is likely overstated, since some Southerners did approve.

CONFIDENCE: 30
